xml_content: gnyis pa ni de bas na mtshan nyid kyi mtshan nyid ni chos gsuM tshang pa'am mtshon bya'i don ldog gzhi' la grub pa zhes bya ba yin te | de nyid mtshon bya mtshon pa'i rgyu mtshan yin pa'i phyir ||This definition is also cited in Rigs gter rang 'grel (ID:5564) [CXRAK3IW] VIII 186,18 chos gsum tshang ba'i mtshon bya'i don ldog gzhi la grub pa zhes gsung ngo ||. Proponents of this view are identified in Rigs gter rol mtsho [32NTDJ66] Dza 70b2 (=586) as followers of Phya pa (ID:3831). According to Rigs gter nyi ma [3C855HMK] 163,8 it is the view of Phya pa (ID:3831) and gTsang nag pa (ID:3839). See also Rigs gter pham byed [7YPPPJ75] Tha 128a6-7 (=255): de la slob dpon phywa pas | 'o na sgrub bya go byed gtan tshigs yang dag gi mtshan nyid du mtshungs so zhes skyon brjod nas | rdzas yod kyi chos gsum tshang ba de mtshan nyid kyi de yin no || zhes zer gtsang nag pa mtshon bya'i don ldog gzhi la grub pa zhes gsung ngo || For gTsang nag pa's position, see bsDus pa (ID:4549) 8a2-4: dgos pa'i mtshan nyid ngos gzung pa ni 'dir mtshan nyid ces bya ba 'ga' zhig thun mong ma yin pa'i tha snyad du mtshon pa la brjod pa na gang du mtshon bya de'i don ldog yin pa ste | tha snyad sgra blo'i zhen yul lam tha snyad du rung pa'i yul yin pa dang | gang mtshon par bya ba'i gzhi la ji ltar dgod par bya ba ltar gnas pa ste | sgrub bya go byed kyi mtshan nyid gang du bsgrub bya'i khyab bya yin pa dang gang bsgrub bya'i gzhi la grub pa'i tshul gnyis yin pa bzhin no ||
